topic: Will injectable, disease-fighting nanobots ever be a reality?
core_question: Does trigger-gated, disease-targeted nanosystem delivery improve target-site payload action while reducing systemic exposure relative to matched nanocarrier and free-drug controls?

hypotheses.name: carrier_equivalence
hypotheses.prediction: no target benefit after exposure normalization

hypotheses.name: trigger_specificity
hypotheses.prediction: targeted opening and payload action are enriched in disease compartment

hypotheses.name: barrier_penalty
hypotheses.prediction: protein corona, flow, matrix, or immune clearance attenuates function

hypotheses.name: translational_robustness
hypotheses.prediction: function persists across lots and staged models within safety limits

decision_rule: joint target localization, trigger-dependent release, pharmacodynamic effect, benefit-risk, and batch-replication threshold
